visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of female hands adorned with gold rings and bracelets is seen untying a dark ribbon with white text from a large, square orange box. The box sits on a flat surface in front of a large window that reveals a bright, high-altitude view of urban skyscrapers. (2) The hands lift the lid of the orange box and place it to the side, exposing layers of white protective tissue paper underneath. The sunlight from the window creates soft shadows within the box. (3) The hands reach into the box and carefully pull out a beige canvas dust bag that features a dark circular logo depicting a horse and carriage. (4) A pale mint-green leather handbag is removed from the dust bag. The bag is shaped like a classic Birkin with silver hardware that is partially wrapped in protective brown paper strips. (5) The hands move to the front of the bag, peeling away the brown paper from the silver turn-lock and horizontal straps. The leather has a fine, pebbled texture. (6) The bag is held up by its dual top handles against the window, rotating slightly to catch the natural daylight, while the blurred cityscape remains visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music with a steady four-on-the-floor beat and bright synthesizer pads begins. A female singer performs upbeat vocal riffs. No speech is present. The mix is clear and favors the music track. (2) Music continues at a constant tempo. A soft, broadband rustling sound is heard, indicating the manipulation of paper or tissue. The music maintains a high arousal level and positive valence. (3) The rhythmic BGM continues. A distinctive fabric-on-fabric friction sound occurs as a bag is pulled from a dust bag. The spectral brightness remains high with dominant high-frequency synth elements. (4) Short, sharp metallic clicks are audible amidst the music, signifying the movement of bag hardware. There are no vocal interruptions or speech segments throughout the track. (5) The track ends with the music still playing. The overall acoustic environment is clean, with intentional incidental noises from the unboxing process mixed into the background of the commercial pop track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a luxury fashion purchase (an Hermès Birkin bag) obtained during a trip to Macau. The video focuses on the sensory experience of unboxing and highlights the specific 'mint green' color and silver hardware of the product in natural light.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While a specific luxury brand is showcased prominently, the video presents as a personal travel haul or unboxing vlog rather than a paid advertisement.
